summary: Virax Biolabs Group Limited filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for August 14, 2026. The agenda includes increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 (2 million ordinary shares) to US$12.5 million (500 million shares) and adopting amended articles of association to reflect the increase. The board unanimously recommends voting for all proposals. This is a routine capital-authorization and charter amendment matter with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. Record date was set for July 27, 2026.
